description: The account's shared Renovate preset: one run a month, minor and patch updates in one pull request and every breaking update in its own, action pins as SHAs, a monthly lock file refresh, every version at least seven days old, no automerge, no Dependency Dashboard.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch and action SHA updates in one pull request: each pull request costs a CI run, and several on the same lockfile conflict with one another. A major stays out of it, in a pull request of its own.
Below 1.0 a minor is the breaking change, as a major is above it: it gets a pull request of its own, so that one red build does not hold back the month's group.
